question_or_proposition: For Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase measurements during Federal FY2025, which enforceable numeric effluent limits apply for compliance comparison—the (*10) limits (497 mg/L / 27,664 lbs/day) or the (*11) limits (449 mg/L / 24,992 lbs/day)—given that footnote *11 states those limits apply during the period beginning three years from the permit effective date through permit expiration and any administrative continuation if not reissued before expiration, while footnote *10 governs the preceding period from the permit effective date through three years from that date?
required_context: Whether and when the permit was administratively continued without reissuance
Dates of Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase monitoring periods in Federal FY2025
Footnote *10 applicability period for the same pollutant
notes: Footnote *11 defines a time-bounded applicability window for one of two parallel TDS Net Increase limit sets. Federal FY2025 may fall on either side of the three-year transition or span it; administrative continuation may extend *11 limit applicability beyond expiration. Resolving which limit set is enforceable for each measurement period directly determines applicable limits and exceedance findings under Purpose A.
